text:
alex: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @nina for saving the demo table today. you sprinted and got the config back up during walk-through 🙌
jamie: YES! that save was legendary. also thank you to @morgan for the last-minute projector rescue :projector:
sanjay: 🏆 Nina, and extra props to facilities for restocking the cupcake tray so we didn't starve
nina: omg team, I just grabbed the HDMI cable from the purple bin and prayed. glad it helped 😂
alex: also shoutout to @jamie for calming the customer while we were flailing — steady voice FTW
morgan: FYI I grabbed an extra box of vanilla in the kitchen. first come, first serve :cupcake:
ops-bot: Reminder: Kitchen inventory updated by morgan at 11:05 — 8 cupcakes remaining
jamie: anyone up for a tiny victory coffee run? I'll grab for whoever wants one :coffee:
sanjay: count me in. and nina, beers/celebratory donuts later? :beers:
nina: Donuts > beers, but I'm flexible. thanks all <3 :tada:
alex: small wins matter. appreciate everyone jumping in. :heart:
morgan: also recording this as 'Team Resilience: Cupcakes Edition' in my notebook for posterity :memo:
jamie: can we get a sticker or badge for Nina? "HDMI Hero" 😂
nina: I'll accept an "HDMI Hero" sticker or more cupcakes. both equally motivating.
